categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in container transportation, container terminal and inland container yard operations, passenger transportation, maritime container and vessel leasing, logistics park development, and international freight forwarding. It also engages in fuel wholesale, gas station operations, vehicle rental, and vehicle maintenance services. The company has diversified into sea and air freight forwarding and cross-border e-commerce logistics through investments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced logistics management systems including electronic data interchange (EDI), autonomous logistics center management systems, and OCR license plate recognition for container yards. It invests in environmentally friendly Euro 6 engines for its vehicle fleet and electric-powered rubber-tired gantry cranes to reduce energy consumption and carbon emissions. Information security is managed through ISO 27001 certified systems, including advanced email attack defense, SIEM, and data loss prevention technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include shipping companies, importers and exporters, logistics providers, retail chains, and e-commerce businesses. The company serves the maritime shipping industry, domestic and international freight forwarders, and passenger transport users. Its logistics park clients include long-term warehouse tenants and cross-border e-commerce operators.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations span major Taiwanese ports including Taoyuan, Taichung, and Kaohsiung, with inland container yards in Taoyuan and Xizhi. The company also has presence in North America, China, Southeast Asia, and Malaysia through its logistics investments. It serves global markets via its international freight forwarding and logistics services.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the maritime logistics supply chain, providing container handling, inland transportation, warehousing, and freight forwarding services. It also leases containers and vessels, supporting upstream shipping operations. Additionally, it offers passenger transport and fuel retail services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding integrated logistics services, upgrading equipment for efficiency and environmental compliance, and developing international logistics centers. R&D focuses on environmental sustainability such as green vehicle fleets and energy-efficient terminal equipment, as well as enhancing information security and automation in logistics operations. The company emphasizes ESG integration and digital transformation to maintain competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through service fees from container transportation, terminal and yard operations, passenger transport fares, leasing of containers and vessels, warehouse rentals, and freight forwarding commissions. Additional income comes from fuel sales at gas stations and vehicle maintenance services. The company also earns from long-term logistics park leases and project-based logistics solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other container terminal operators, inland container yards, and logistics providers in Taiwan and the Asia-Pacific region. It leverages its affiliation with Evergreen Marine and diversified logistics services to maintain a strong market position. The company is recognized for stable profitability and operational scale, with competitive advantages in integrated logistics and environmental initiatives.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$21.2 billion in the latest fiscal year, representing a 29.6% increase year-over-year. Net profit after tax was around NT$2.9 billion, with steady growth in assets and equity. Investments in equipment and logistics infrastructure support ongoing expansion, and the company maintains a stable financial position with positive cash flows and moderate leverage.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, safe, and environmentally friendly logistics services, integrating container handling, transportation, warehousing, and freight forwarding into seamless solutions. Its commitment to sustainability, including green vehicle fleets and ISO-certified environmental and information security management systems, differentiates it in the market. Long-term contracts and diversified service offerings enhance customer reliability and operational efficiency.
